Bio: Every member of the team exclusively drives a TYPE-86 series car. Being slow on both straights and corners, they are the ideal opponents for a warm-up.
A mixed team combining TYPE-DC2 and EK9 models. Since most of their cars are stock, there is virtually no worry of being pulled away from on the straights.
Composed entirely of four-door super sedans. While their outright speed is modest on average, they employ a solid racing style based on disciplined blocking.
Although lacking a unified philosophy, their lineup features high-baseline performance cars. Many of their drivers struggle in corners, making that the ideal place to attack.
An eight-man team unified by large four-door sedans. As expected of heavy sedans, cornering is their greatest vulnerability.
While none of the regular members have exceptionally fast cars, the leader's AE86T features a maxed-out engine stage and cannot be underestimated.
A team centered around TYPE-S13 and S14 chassis. The average member's skill is unremarkable, but the leader's S15 is a formidable opponent.
A team comprised of rotary TYPE-FC and FD models. True to their name ("Twister"), they make violent maneuvers in corners, so care is needed not to be thrown off.
A large gang organized around the TYPE-AE86 series. Since nearly all of them rely on a drift-based style, their cornering speed is relatively quick.
They boast high overall straightaway speed and leave few openings. It is best to attack aggressively, pushing through decisively in the turns.
A team with many female drivers, running exclusively on AWD TYPE-CE9A and CP9E platforms. Their overall tune stages are high, so securing an early lead is vital.
A massive nine-driver syndicate fielding almost exclusively TYPE-R series cars. Unless your vehicle is tuned to the maximum, you will face an exhausting battle.
Unified strictly under the AWD TYPE-GC8. They have a strong overall tendency to launch into a ferocious pursuit whenever a gap opens up, so stay vigilant.
A team built around mid-engine TYPE-NA2 models. Those with engine tuning at Stage 3 or above, including the leader, are exceptionally tough opponents.
A six-member squad running diverse car models. Although not all members have maxed-out upgrade stages, their overall skill level is remarkably high.
A team composed entirely of female drivers. However, their collective skill is exceedingly high, so taking them lightly will result in painful defeat.
Every driver pilots a different model, but they rarely make driving errors; if you slip up, catching back up to them will be extremely difficult.
A team running exclusively rotary TYPE-FC and FD machines. Extreme caution is warranted against the fierce onslaught of the Soramidera brothers, led by the elder sibling.
A team distinguished by cars with superior factory base specs. Consequently, even without maxed-out upgrade stages, their top-end straightaway pull is impressive.
A heavyweight nine-member syndicate of the upper echelon. At this level, even the ordinary members possess exceptional driving technique.
